name: Dominique Thorne
profileSummary: Dominique Thorne is an American actress. She began her career with appearances in the films If Beale Street Could Talk (2018) and Judas and the Black Messiah (2021). In 2022, she began playing Riri Williams / Ironheart with the Marvel Cinematic Universe feature film Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, a role she reprised in the 2025 Disney+ miniseries Ironheart. In 2024, she starred in the Anna Boden and Ryan Fleck film Freaky Tales.
